summary: Interleaved tool validation hop causes elevated tail latency and sporadic request timeouts
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (AuroraDocs, enterprise) reports a rise in end-to-end inference latency beginning ~2026-03-09 23:00 UTC. A subset of requests that invoke tool/function calls intermittently hit request timeouts (gateway 504) while non-tool calls remain within normal latency. Initial triage indicates an extra synchronous validation step for tool schemas (validator-service) has been observed to interleave with streaming token delivery, adding multiple synchronous hops and increasing tail latency.

Impact:
- Customer sees 10-15% of tool-invoking requests timing out (504) during peak; SLO breaches for their service.
- Affects production in us-east region for models that commonly use tool calls (gptx-llama-7b and open-instruct-3b).
- Business impact: user-facing feature failures and elevated error rates; customer escalated to enterprise SLA channel.

Environment:
- Redwood hosted, prod-us-east, dedicated capacity for AuroraDocs.
- Path: API Gateway -> Function Proxy -> Validator Service (schema check) -> Function Proxy -> Serving Runtime -> Model.

Observed behavior:
- End-to-end traces show additional sync RPC from function-proxy to validator-service for every tool call. Validator occasionally blocks while waiting for schema cache miss and then performs a synchronous remote fetch (cache-miss latency ~120-300ms). When validation queue builds up, function-proxy holds streaming until validation completes, causing tail latency spikes and eventual client timeouts.

Expected behavior:
- Tool schema validation should be async or cached locally in function-proxy to avoid blocking streaming token delivery. Cache-miss should not add more than ~10ms to p95.

Immediate workaround:
- Temporary config to bypass remote validation for trusted enterprise customers (toggle available but not yet applied for AuroraDocs).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use AuroraDocs prod credentials to call the chat API with a prompt that triggers two tool calls in sequence (tool A then tool B).
2) Ensure model is pinned to gptx-llama-7b and request in us-east region via 'region=us-east-1'.
3) Enable streaming on the request and observe time-to-first-byte and interleaved token stream events.
4) Replay high-concurrency load (100 concurrent sessions) for ~5 minutes to reproduce tail latency and occasional gateway 504s.
5) Correlate traces by request-id between api-gateway, function-proxy, and validator-service to see extra validation RPCs on the critical path.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 02:14 UTC - SRE collected traces from api-gateway; spike in latency aligns with increased validator_service errors and cache-miss rate.
Validator service change (PR #421) deployed 2026-03-08 introduced a synchronous fetch on cache-miss to central schema store; previously the fetch was async with local buffering.
Cache metrics: validator-service 'schema_cache_hit' dropped from 99.2% to 87.4% during regression window; cache-miss latency percentiles 120ms (p50) / 260ms (p95).
Function-proxy shows backpressure: streaming hold time correlates linearly with validator queue depth; holding tokens until validation completes.
No evidence of serving-runtime or GPU saturation for affected job pools; CPU on validator-service spiked during cache miss storms.
Synthetic test: toggling validator-service to 'local-cache-only' eliminated timeouts in a 30-minute load test.

Hypothesis: recent validator PR prioritized strict schema freshness and introduced synchronous remote fetch on miss; combined with increased tool usage this leads to blocking on critical path causing p99 tail spikes and 504s.
comments: [2026-03-10 03:05] Maya Patel (Support): Customer reported ~12% timeout rate for tool-using chat flows. Asked for request-ids and example payloads. Customer provided three failing request IDs and full traces.

[2026-03-10 04:20] Liam O'Connor (SRE): Confirmed extra RPCs in traces. Noted validator-service PR #421 as a likely regression candidate. Opening investigation with validator and function-proxy owners.

[2026-03-10 06:40] Priya Rao (Validator owner): Reproduced locally. On cache-miss we now synchronously call central-schema-store which can add 100-300ms. Will prepare an emergency patch to fallback to async fetch on miss for prod.

[2026-03-10 08:10] Support (to customer): We have identified a validation cache-miss path as likely root cause. Temporarily can enable bypass for your org while we patch. Requested permission to enable bypass toggle (non-destructive).
[2026-03-10 09:05] AuroraDocs (Customer): Approved bypass for their org for immediate mitigation. Asked for ETA on permanent fix and assurances on schema correctness.

[2026-03-10 11:30] Priya Rao: Hotfix PR opened to return cached 'stale-while-revalidate' result on cache-miss and trigger async remote refresh. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/validator-service/pull/427
[2026-03-10 13:20] Liam O'Connor: Deployed bypass for AuroraDocs at 2026-03-10 12:50 UTC. Observed immediate drop in 504s for their traffic in prod (from 12% to <1%).
[2026-03-11 10:00] Product/Policy: Need follow-up to ensure bypass toggle has audit trail and opt-out is safe for other enterprise customers.
resolution_notes: Mitigation applied: 2026-03-10 12:50 UTC - org-level validator bypass enabled for AuroraDocs; customer 504s dropped to <1%. Hotfix PR #427 merged and promoted to canary 2026-03-11 04:30 UTC implementing 'stale-while-revalidate' for schema cache-miss (serves last-known schema immediately and refreshes asynchronously). Full rollout to prod scheduled 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC pending extended canary. Post-deploy monitoring plan: 72-hour elevated telemetry watch on validator cache miss rate, p95/p99 of tool-invoking flows, and error budget burn alerts. Follow-ups: (1) Postmortem to be authored and linked to incident (owner: Liam O'Connor), due 2026-03-17. (2) Add a unit and e2e test to prevent future sync-fetch on cache-miss paths (owner: Priya Rao).
notes_for_followup: Create runbook entry for validator-service cache-miss mitigation and bypass toggle procedure.
Add automated alert that correlates validator cache-miss spike with streaming hold time in function-proxy.
Review permissive defaults for enterprise customers and document audit implications of bypass toggles.
